messages.subject: NBLAST online error
messages.body_plain:
Hello Dr. Jefferis,
I just started using this amazing tool, and I am feeling behind the times. Recently, when I tried to launch NBLAST online, an error occurs and the application fails to start.
Error in eval(quote({ :
The Shiny package was not found in the library.

Regards,
Jaison

messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] NBLAST online error
messages.body_plain:
Dear Jason,

Many thanks for the heads up. Someone updated the OS on the server on Friday and in so doing the version of R which is what runs the underlying code. I have reinstalled the missing packages for the new version of R and the server appears to be running again normally now.

Best wishes,

Greg.
